name: Scoundrel’s Gambit
body:
Aura faint evocation; CL 1st; Slot —; Price 100 gp; Weight —

DESCRIPTION

This fluted silver tube bears tiny runes etched between the grooves. Barely 2 inches long, this device easily hides within a sleeve, ready for when you need it most. Card sharps working dangerous gambling halls as well as dancing girls and prostitutes in grim bordellos frequently keep one of these nearby. Held in hand and using the command word and a standard action, you fire off a single magic missile at a chosen target within 100 ft.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Feats Craft Wondrous Item, Spells magic missile; Cost 50 gp
